invariants.rationale: The method accesses 'tile' fields or methods and passes it to other functions, indicating it is expected to be non-null.
tileElement is dereferenced for getChildByName, so it must be non-null at this program point.
If the child named 'objectgroup' is present, its name should equal 'objectgroup', reflecting standard XML element structure.
If there is an 'objectgroup' element, then calling getChildrenByName('object') should not return null.
The list of 'object' children in 'objectgroup' should have a non-negative size if present.
